member.summary: Provides functionality to read text files and expose their contents as a data reader with each line represented as a row.
member.remarks: This class implements the ITextReader interface to enable integration with data processing workflows that consume IDataReader instances. Each line of the input text file is treated as a separate row with a single column named "Line". This design allows for simple line-by-line processing of text files using standard data access patterns.
